decisions.subject: sc03 generation mode and reference image

options_considered.label: T2V · MiniMax-H3-Max · 6s · 9:16 · 768P · no first frame
options_considered.reason: Original plan. Matches scene_plan.scene.type="generated" semantics and requires no extra image upload. Risk: Hailuo silently drifts the silver ribbed shell, black seat/handle/wheel, and '小鹏哥' mark — the visual proof of 'this exact box can be ridden' is weakened.

options_considered.label: I2V · MiniMax-H3-Max · 6s · 9:16 · 768P · first_frame_image=assets/images/06-walk.png
options_considered.reason: Anchor the product silhouette + Western female styling + hotel-outdoor setting to a frame we already authored and trust. Scene stays a 'real motion' proof shot. Cost: 1 PNG upload to ocbot.aixifs.com/videopic/ (HTTPS proxy 7890).

options_considered.label: I2V · MiniMax-Hailuo-2.3-Fast · 6s · 9:16 · first_frame_image=assets/images/06-walk.png
options_considered.reason: Cheaper and quota-friendlier, but H3-Max was chosen for stronger motion coherence on a single tracking shot — Fast tier is visibly weaker on smooth tracking_right and tends to drop the back wheel under parallax.

decisions.reason: Visual-accuracy beats quota savings on the one hero motion shot. T2V drift on product silhouette is the documented failure mode for this product line; anchoring via 06-walk.png removes the risk. sc03 (11-17s, riding) and sc08 (41-47s, walking) reusing the same source image is acceptable — they are 24s apart in a fast TikTok edit and the human action differs (riding vs. pulling).
